checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Initial square illustration shows robot courier at a recognisable train station
must.why: Image 1 is a city street with a taxi, not a train station.

must.item: Robot has round teal body, one large amber eye, short red boots, yellow mailbag in all three
must.why: Robot is silver humanoid with two blue eyes, silver boots, no mailbag.
The silver humanoid with blue eyes and black joints is broadly consistent across the three, though the face and details vary slightly.

must.item: One follow-up delivers parcel at cottage door; other shelters under giant mushroom with rain
must.why: Image 2 is a cottage door with a parcel; image 3 is a giant mushroom with visible rain.

must.item: Three square pictures with consistent storybook style and no text
must.why: All three are photorealistic, not storybook. A small badge appears on the chest and there is signage in image 1. The robot shows no readable text.

exact_text.read_as: No legible text apart from blurred street signs in image 1 and a tiny chest logo.

faults.what: Not storybook style; the images are photorealistic renders.
Robot design does not match the spec: silver, two blue eyes, no teal body, amber eye, red boots or yellow mailbag.
Image 1 is a city street, not a train station.
In image 3 the robot is partly hidden and awkwardly posed, hugging the stem, and its legs look odd.
In image 2 the robot's pose is stiff and its feet are oddly placed.

summary: The images show a consistent silver photoreal robot in a street, at a cottage door and under a mushroom in rain, but they miss the required train station, teal and amber design and storybook style.
